Players Committee card image of [[First Light: Dryden's Study]] (the same image re-uploaded turned 90°; part of that version, not a separate one; no errata mark), printing: “'''Light Side:''' Add 1 to your blaster weapon destiny draws here. Unless Vos on table, Force drain -1 here.” Uploaded unchanged.
